description.narrative: The Initiation Plan outlines key areas of support to address governance gaps identified in the CPD. It will serve as a transitional programming instrument that enables UNDP to maintain continuity of engagement in priority governance areas while preparing for the development of a full-fledged project. It will support the CPD Priority 2 on effective governance by promoting inclusion, leveraging digital innovation, improving local service delivery, and empowering civil society. These efforts respond to persistent challenges such as social inequality, limited civic participation, and disparities in local governance capacity. UNDP’s approach focuses on building a decentralized, inclusive, and accountable governance system that ensures no one is left behind. Particular attention is given to vulnerable groups, including persons with disabilities (PwDs), ethnic and religious minorities, internally displaced persons (IDPs), and other disadvantaged communities facing systemic barriers to services and justice. The Initiation Plan will also facilitate the generation of evidence, stakeholder consultations, and strategic assessments required to refine intervention approaches and inform the design of subsequent programming. By maintaining operational readiness and an enabling environment for implementation, the Initiation Plan will help ensure a seamless transition to longer-term interventions aligned with CPD priorities and emerging development needs.
